cases.name: a command dispatched in a read warns and runs in an update

log: updateEditorSync: an editor update (e.g. a command listener that mutates the editor) ran while a read-only context was on the stack. This most commonly happens when a command is dispatched from inside editor.read(). The update has been deferred to a fresh writable update so it still applies, but dispatching mutations from a read-only context is an anti-pattern — dispatch after editor.read() returns, or via queueMicrotask.
